summary: Phase 3 buyer + public-homepage frontend testing on preview URL. Verified: public homepage (desktop + mobile), login redirect, buyer home, get-flowers form (mobile-only submit works), draft partial preservation, Buy Again flow, events/offers/orders empty states, no RFQ/Quote terminology on buyer surfaces, no forbidden 'FloraSetu QC' strings, regressions for supplier/logistics/admin. CRITICAL: Get Flowers form cannot be submitted on desktop or tablet (>=768px) because the Review/Submit buttons live inside .fs-sticky-bar which has 'display:none' at >=768px. The full offers-comparison / order-timeline / evidence-pack / delivery-acceptance / issue-reporting flows were NOT exercised — API-assisted setup could reach requirement submit (QUICK auto-publish) but the resulting RFQ never appeared in demo.supplier's inbox (GET /api/demand/rfqs returned {items:[]}), so no quote could be created to drive the buyer offers UI. Root cause of empty supplier inbox not diagnosed here (backend routing / preview seed / supplier org catalog scope). Same blocker as iteration_14.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 404 NOT_FOUND. Correct path appears to be GET /api/demand/rfqs (also has /rfqs/inbox). Please align OpenAPI + testing docs — the review request references /api/demand/inbox which does not exist.
Returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR when called by supplier. Even if this is not the canonical inbox endpoint, it should 404 or 403, not 500.

After successful submit (200, status SUBMITTED) the RFQ does NOT appear in the demo.supplier@florasetu.dev inbox (GET /api/demand/rfqs → {items:[]}). Could be a routing rule / catalog capability / seed issue. Blocks the whole buyer offer/order/evidence-pack UI test path.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Review/Submit buttons live inside .fs-sticky-bar which is display:none at min-width:768px. On desktop and tablet the buyer fills the form but has no way to submit — the Review request / Get offers CTAs are invisible. Buyer must resize to <768px to send a request. Fix: either always render the action bar (drop display:none for desktop, restyle inline), or add an equivalent desktop CTA inside the form.

ui_bugs.component: PublicHomePage — Get started / Join FloraSetu buttons (.pub-btn--primary)
ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: Text is unreadable — computed styles: background rgb(24,61,51) (dark green) with color rgb(34,48,43) (dark charcoal). Contrast ratio ~1.1:1, far below WCAG AA. Label 'Get started' visually invisible; same button style is reused elsewhere (public-hero-cta, public-how-cta, public-audience-*, public-event-cta, public-supplier-cta). Fix .pub-btn--primary color to white/near-white.

MINOR: When the user starts filling the form, navigates to Home, then returns via 'Get flowers' nav, quantity/unit/destination are preserved but the Flower selection is dropped (product not restored). The rest of the form is present, but Review request stays disabled because product is required.

MINOR (docs mismatch): review request expected testids bottom-nav-home/offers/orders/events/more but actual are buyer-nav-home-bottom / buyer-nav-offers-bottom / buyer-nav-orders-bottom / buyer-nav-events-bottom / buyer-bottomnav-more. Nav functionally works. Only flag if the review-request naming is authoritative.
MINOR: review request references testid 'org-switcher' but the shell exposes 'workspace-switcher' instead. Element is functional and visible.

integration_issues.flow: Offers / comparison / order-timeline / evidence-pack / delivery-acceptance / issue-report / events sourcing
integration_issues.issue: Not exercised end-to-end. Blocker: after QUICK requirement submit the RFQ does not surface in demo.supplier's inbox, so no quote can be produced. Cannot drive the Compare offers → Select offer → Order timeline → Evidence pack → Accept delivery → Report an issue chain in the browser. Same blocker as reported in iteration_14 (was seed-pilot-order.sh dep in iter 14; now RFQ routing in iter 15).

issues: Primary green CTA button has near-invisible dark text due to color:rgb(34,48,43) on rgb(24,61,51). Fix the .pub-btn--primary text color.
Uses browser-native <input type='datetime-local'> for required date & time — inconsistent with the app's design system on desktop; acceptable on mobile.

action_items: CRITICAL: Make the Get Flowers Review/Submit buttons reachable on desktop and tablet — either drop the display:none rule on .fs-sticky-bar >=768px for this page or add a duplicate desktop CTA inside the form.
HIGH: Fix .pub-btn--primary contrast on the public homepage — text is invisible on the dark-green background (Get started / Join FloraSetu and every audience/event/supplier CTA).
MEDIUM: Persist the selected flower (productId) in the Get Flowers draft alongside qty/unit/dest so that navigating away and back does not clear it.

INVESTIGATE (backend/seed): QUICK requirement auto-publish should route the RFQ to demo.supplier's inbox so the buyer offers/order/evidence-pack UI can be exercised. Currently supplier inbox stays empty. Also: /api/demand/inbox 404s and /api/demand/quotes/inbox 500s — clean up or document.
OPTIONAL: Align testids with the review-request naming (org-switcher, bottom-nav-*) or update the review-request spec to match the shell (workspace-switcher, buyer-nav-*-bottom).
critical_code_review_comments: components/StickyMobileActionBar.tsx + design/components.css: the sticky action bar is used to host the ONLY submit path on GetFlowersPage; combining that with a hard 'display:none' at >=768px silently disables the entire flow on desktop. Either always render the bar or split desktop/mobile CTAs.
design/public.css .pub-btn--primary appears to inherit the wrong text color — either add color:#fff or a foreground token; verify against WCAG AA (>=4.5:1).

GetFlowersPage saves draft to localStorage but appears to drop the product reference on rehydrate — restore product by re-fetching /api/catalog/products/:id (or persist a minimal {id,name,code} snapshot in the draft).

The review-request references GET /api/demand/inbox but the API exposes GET /api/demand/rfqs (with /rfqs/inbox as an alias). Consider adding an explicit /api/demand/inbox route (or updating the spec) to reduce onboarding friction.

rca_of_the_issue: Desktop submit blocker RCA: /app/apps/web/src/pages/GetFlowersPage.tsx lines 300–315 wraps both the Review-request and Get-offers buttons inside <StickyMobileActionBar>. That component renders <div class='fs-sticky-bar'>… whose CSS in /app/apps/web/src/design/components.css:186 sets '@media (min-width:768px) { .fs-sticky-bar { display: none; } }'. On any viewport >=768px this hides the container and therefore the ONLY submit CTAs. Reproduce: viewport 1440x900 → /buyer/requests/new → fill flower/qty/unit/date/dest → no visible CTA. Mitigation: (a) remove the 768px display:none for this page's sticky bar and restyle to be non-fixed on desktop, (b) or render a second in-form <button data-testid='get-flowers-review-btn'> outside the sticky bar for desktop, guarded by a matching CSS breakpoint.
